text: Entry Requirements 1.Applicants must be a citizen of a country other than the People's Republic of China,and being good health. For the applicant who was originally a Chinese citizen and joined a foreign nationality, TUFE implements No.12 Notice of the Ministry of Education(2020). 2.The requirements for applicants' degree and age are that applicants must: (1) be a high school graduate over the age 18 and under the age of 30 when applying for the undergraduate programs. Applicants who have not reached the age of 18 before the date of registration for the new semester, he/she shall submit the original notarization certificate of the guardian issued by the Tianjin Notarization Office. The guardian must be a resident with permanent residence in Tianjin. 3.The applicant must conduct well and be physically and mentally healthy. To respect Chinese culture,and be willing to abide by the laws and regulations of China and the rules and regulations of Tianjin University of Finance and Economics is a must. 4.HSK 4 certificate.
